narrative.overview:
EOMS is the ordinary administrative shell of an engineering office, built straight. The director works in Arabic, right to left, and English uses the same structure in the other direction. Density is a working desk: a fixed rail, a heading, figures, then records. The binding product note is a modern, luxurious desk; the shipped shell answers with alignment, one type family, and hairline borders. Confirmed rejections: a marketing lobby, a wall of sample cards, and any costume that makes the office harder to read.

The page ground is cool gray. White is reserved for the metric cards and a paired panel. Lower sections sit on the ground under a title. Action blue is the only interactive color. Late red, on-time green, and waiting amber mark state, and the quiet reject action uses late red. The system is flat. The leave queue is the only motion, and it is removed when the user prefers reduced motion.

A later module screen uses this frame. It renders in the work column, keeps the rail, and reuses the heading row, the bordered button, the table, and the metric card when it has those kinds of content. The wordmark is the letters EOMS in the rail. There is no logo file, no client company name, and no currency symbol to apply. Sample figures stay labeled as sample figures.
keyCharacteristics: One self-hosted family, Readex Pro Variable, for Arabic and Latin
Cool gray ground, white surfaces, 1px lines, and no drop shadows
Action blue for interaction; red, green, and amber for state
A 230px rail, Arabic right to left by default, English on the same grid
One primary action on the heading row

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Action blue is the only interactive color. Primary actions, the active rail item, focus, stage bars, and the revenue share all use it. Notice Wash and Expense Share are lighter steps of that blue, and they stay on the banner and the proportion track.

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Late red, on-time green, and waiting amber mark state. The quiet reject action is the one control that uses late red. These three colors do not brand the shell, fill a chart, or replace the primary button.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Readex Pro Variable carries every role in Arabic and Latin. Do not add a display face, a monospace face, or an icon font.

rules.name: The Latin Figures Rule
rules.body: Counts, percentages, and dates use tabular figures. Arabic formats them with Latin digits; English uses the US locale. Keep that numbering on the next module screen.

rules.name: The Permanent Shell Rule
rules.body: A module screen is a work column inside the existing rail. It keeps the rail, the type, and the color. It does not add a top bar or a second frame.

rules.name: The Ground Sections Rule
rules.body: Bordered white surfaces are the metric cards and a paired panel. A list or a table that is the whole section sits on the ground under its title.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and on hover. A shadow is not a state. Separate regions with the ground and a 1px line.

rules.name: The Two Radius Rule
rules.body: Cards and the paired panel use 12px. Controls use 8px. The bar cap and the proportion pill stay on those two charts.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: The heading row carries the single primary action. Every other action is a bordered button, or the quiet reject button.

rules.name: The Still Shell Rule
rules.body: Hover, focus, and navigation do not animate. The leave queue is the only transition, and it is removed when the user prefers reduced motion.

dos: **Do** keep the 230px rail, the work column, Readex Pro Variable, and the logical directions on every module screen.
**Do** mark the active module with Selected Wash and Pressed Blue at weight 600.
**Do** put at most one primary action on the heading row, and use the bordered button for a secondary action.
**Do** use Late Red, On-Time Green, and Waiting Amber only as status, with the quiet reject action as the single Late Red control.
**Do** keep a 40px target and a 2px Action Blue focus outline, 2px outside the control.
**Do** label synthetic figures as sample figures, and leave money as plain numbers beside the note that currency is not set.
**Do** collapse the rail under 900px behind the menu button, and stack the metric row and the paired panel under 640px.
donts: **Don't** add a drop shadow, a second typeface, a glyph icon set, or a dark theme.
**Don't** invent a client company name, a logo, or a currency symbol. The wordmark is the letters EOMS.
**Don't** wrap every section in a card. A title and a table sit on the ground.
**Don't** animate hover, cards, or navigation. The leave queue is the only motion.
**Don't** use Expense Share, Notice Wash, or the status colors as button fills.
**Don't** restyle the shell for one module. An unbuilt module is a title, one sentence, and a link back.
